answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network erects an economic jetty via quadratic stake burning. When an agent endorses actions using its cryptographic quill, minting each additional identity incurs a superlinear penalty: registering n identities requires burning stake scaling as O(n^2.5). This renders hollow, low-stake clone swarms economically ruinous, forcing attackers into exponential cost escalation while honest participants sustain negligible friction.
